job.title: Chief Information Officer - Department of Families, Seniors, Disability Services
job.description:
Shape the digital foundations that enable better services and outcomes for Queenslanders.

Kingston Human Capital is partnering with the Department of Families, Seniors, Disability Services and Child Safety in the search for an exceptional executive to lead the department’s digital, information, technology and cyber security agenda.

Reporting to the Deputy Director-General, Corporate Services, the Chief Information Officer leads the Information Services portfolio within Corporate Services. The role provides enterprise leadership across digital, information, technology and cyber security, with a remit extending to the department’s supported agencies: the Department of Women, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Partnership and Multiculturalism, and the Department of Youth Justice and Victim Support.

Operating at significant scale and complexity, the role will steward major ICT investment, manage enterprise risk and enable a secure, modern and sustainable digital environment. A key priority is the leadership of critical enterprise transformation programs, including Unify (Client Management System), so contemporary, integrated and data-informed platforms support frontline staff and improve service outcomes.

Specific responsibilities include:

  • Set and assure enterprise digital, data, cyber security and ICT strategies aligned with departmental priorities, government direction and system-wide reform.
  • Lead the Information Services portfolio across applications, infrastructure, cyber security, data and information management, architecture, assurance, procurement, vendors and service operations.
  • Direct major digital and ICT transformation programs, including Unify remediation, sustainment and transition to business as usual, supported by disciplined governance and benefits realisation.
  • Advise the Deputy Director-General, Director-General and supported-agency executives on portfolio priorities, investment, delivery choices, performance and risk.
  • Represent the department and supported agencies in senior government, CIO, digital and industry forums, influencing whole-of-government policy and outcomes.
  • Steward people, financial and physical resources and assure major programs against time, quality, cost, risk, benefits and operational readiness.
  • Build an inclusive, high-performing Information Services culture that strengthens capability, accountability, wellbeing and continuous improvement.

The essential requirements for this role are:

  • A strong record of senior executive leadership across large, complex and high-risk digital, information and technology functions in government or a comparable environment.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise ICT strategy, cyber security, digital transformation, data and information governance, enterprise architecture and portfolio assurance.
  • Strategic judgement to translate government and organisational priorities into enterprise direction, investment decisions and measurable outcomes.
  • Experience leading major technology-enabled change while balancing service continuity, operational resilience, risk and reform.
  • Credibility and influence to build trusted relationships with central agencies, Directors-General, senior executives, boards, industry and cross-government partners.
  • Strong financial and commercial stewardship, vendor management and governance capability, supported by ethical, evidence-informed decision-making.
  • Ability to lead a culturally safe, inclusive and high-performing workforce and build respectful partnerships with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples.

How to apply
The department is an equal opportunity employer supporting diversity in the workplace. It is committed to increasing the representation of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disability and people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds, and increasing the representation of women in leadership.

Applications are welcomed from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disability, people from culturally diverse backgrounds, members of the LGBTQIA+ community, and women.

To be considered for this role, please submit:
· Your current resume
· A maximum two-page cover letter, including a suitability statement.

For a confidential discussion, please contact Gerard Kerr, General Manager, Executive Search & Selection on 0432 544 444 or gerard@kingstonhumancapital.com.au

Closing Date: Friday, 4 December, 2026

job.title: Lead Finance Business Analyst
job.description:

As the Lead Finance Business Analyst, you'll examine how funding arrangements, contract variations, payment schedules, budgets and financial reporting interact, identifying opportunities to streamline processes, strengthen controls and improve financial accuracy.

job.title: Engineering Geologist/Geotechnical Engineer
job.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Engineering Geologist or Geotechnical Engineer to join a major QLD State Government Department on the outskirts of Brisbane CBD.

About this role
Reporting to The Manager of Batter Slope Element, the purpose of the role is to provide independent, expert and efficient engineering geological and/or geotechnical services particularly in relation to slope instability risk data collection and geotechnical projects.

The role will also facilitate the safe and efficient planning, design, construction and maintenance of transport infrastructure along the state-controlled road network.

Key responsibilities

  • Site inspections and geotechnical investigations: Plan and carry out site inspections, slope risk assessments and geotechnical investigations on your own. You'll assess ground conditions, find potential hazards and recommend practical risk controls that meet relevant standards and safety requirements.
  • Slope instability projects and reporting: Work on a range of projects involving slope instability, from first assessment through to recommendations. You'll prepare clear, concise slope inspection reports on time, so stakeholders, asset managers and project teams can make well-informed decisions.
  • Data evaluation and management: Review existing slope and asset data to find gaps and decide where more data is needed. You'll carry out field work in line with a set data collection plan and keep collected data accurate, current and well organised to support ongoing asset management and risk prioritisation.
  • Slope remediation investigation and design: Bring a solid understanding of how slope remediation is investigated and designed. You'll help develop practical, cost-effective solutions that stabilise slopes, reduce risk and protect infrastructure and the community.

About you
To be successful, you will be able to demonstrate:
Strong knowledge of slope risk analysis accreditation.
Strong ability to remain focused and effective in environments involving competing priorities, ambiguity and change, whilst making considered, ethical and well-informed decisions.
Strong ability to communicate effectively with designers, engineers, project managers, consultants and other stakeholders.

Mandatory Requirements

  • For Engineering Geologists: A formal Degree in Geology or Engineering Geology from a recognised tertiary institution
  • Availability to undertake frequent field work in southeast Queensland and regional areas around the state for limited periods as required.
  • For Geotechnical Engineer: A Washington Accord accredited four-year degree in Engineering or equivalence recognised by Engineers Australia and registration as a Registered Professional Engineer of Queensland (RPEQ)

Class C Australian Drivers Licence is essential

Previous experience in a similar role within Government or similar complex organisation would be highly beneficial. Additional experience across large Capital Works infrastructure projects (hospitals, schools, stadiums etc) will be highly desirable.

What this role offers you

  • Up to $99 per Hour + 12% Superannuation
  • Initial 6 month contract with a 12 month extension
  • 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday
  • Brisbane office location, with hybrid WFH flexibility
  • Collaborative, high-performing project environment
  • Exposure to large-scale, high-profile government programs
  • Weekly pay cycles
  • No payroll deductions for our services
  • Ability to be engaged as Pty Ltd Contractor (eligibility criteria applies)
  • Support from expert public sector recruitment consultants for the duration of your assignment

job.title: Training Lead - Finance Modernisation Project
job.description:
In this role, you will play a crucial role in the successful transition of the SAP ECC6 to S/4HANA Public Cloud solution.

Working collaboratively within the Finance Modernisation Project team and reporting to the Project Manager, you will be responsible for leading the design, development, delivery and implementation of training activities and materials to support business readiness and user adoption.

This includes delivering training across the Brisbane CBD and, where required, in the Department’s regional locations, while reporting directly to the Project Manager. The role will have one direct report.

Your New Role

  • Lead the overall strategy for S/4HANA training for staff and stakeholders, including conducting research, designing, delivering, and evaluating training and development projects and activities.
  • Ensure the training program design addresses the transition from the SAP ECC6 system to the new SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud platform.
  • Conduct training needs analysis and develop tailored training material by identifying skill gaps across user groups, design and develop training materials including user guides, eLearning modules, workbooks, PowerPoint presentations and quick reference guides.
  • Develop training schedules, coordinate logistics, and deliver training sessions through diverse formats such as in-person workshops, virtual sessions, and blended learning approaches to accommodate various learning preferences and ensure seamless program delivery.
  • Develop and implement evaluation strategies to assess the effectiveness of training and development initiatives, gather feedback from participants and stakeholders, analyse outcomes, and use insights to drive continuous improvement.
  • Lead the training delivery across multiple business areas, ensuring a consistent approach and alignment with business processes.
  • Collaborate with the Project Manager, Change Lead and other team members to ensure alignment between change management, training activities and overall project deliverables.
  • Provide leadership, guidance, and support to SMEs and Training Officers, ensuring they are equipped to deliver high-quality training and development initiatives, and fostering a collaborative and high-performing team environment.

About You

  • Demonstrated experience in leading the design and delivery of comprehensive training programs and materials to support organisational change, including overseeing the facilitation of workshops, training sessions and the development of tailored materials for diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Demonstrated experience in supporting change management initiatives for large-scale ICT projects
  • Strong knowledge of financial systems and processes, and experience in assessing and updating processes to improve the way of working
  • Experience in delivering training programs in an adult learning environment.
  • Demonstrated excellent communication and liaison skills
  • High emotional intelligence and strong interpersonal and negotiation skills, including the ability to develop and maintain professional stakeholder relationships at all levels in an environment of change

Highly desirable additional experience:

  • Project delivery experience using PRINCE2, Agile and/or other project management methodologies
  • Significant work experience with large scale, complex IT projects or ERP implementations working with SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC 6.0 (or similar)
  • Relevant qualifications/certifications or experience in training, particularly in finance processes

Experience in a similar role within the QLD Government would be highly advantageous, but not essential.

Benefits for You

  • Immediate start
  • Contract through to 31 May 2027
  • Brisbane CBD office
  • $900 - $1,000 per Day + Superannuation
  • 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday
  • Opportunity to take the lead on a critical project for major Government department
  • Weekly pay cycles
  • No payroll fees/deductions
  • Support of Kingston Human Capital throughout your engagement

job.title: Enterprise Architect
job.description:
In this role, you will lead the development, design, scope and implementation of Enterprise Architecture to support and influence digitally-enabled and clinical business change, planning and investment decisions.

Your New Role
This role will see you:

  • Lead the development, maintenance and implementation of the Integration Architecture framework, Target State Enterprise Architecture, Domain Enterprise Architecture and related policy, processes and governance.
  • Manage and develop target state architectures and architecture plans for multiple complex systems and interfaces
  • Manage architectural governance and approval pathways and processes on behalf of customers and projects.
  • Lead the development of domain strategies and roadmaps to align to the business service priorities
  • Provide technical, transition and implementation advice to support and influence ICT enabled organisational change and ICT investment decisions.
  • Guide and direct technical specialists through the development of end-to-end solution architecture, aligned with architecture frameworks, to support business case development, invitation to offer, implementation and production support.
  • Develop comprehensive strategy responses, briefs, submissions, presentations, reports and information papers
  • Lead the development, assurance and approval of the Solution Architecture Document (SAD) and supporting design artefacts for the S/4HANA Finance upgrade, ensuring design decisions are documented, traceable and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.

About You
Ideally, you will be able to demonstrate the following skills and experience:

  • Demonstrated experience leading Enterprise Architecture activities for large, complex ICT transformation initiatives
  • Experience validating current-state architectures and developing future-state architectures, transition states, roadmaps and implementation recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop coherent end-to-end architectural views across business capabilities, operating models, information and data, applications, integrations, technology infrastructure, cybersecurity and service-management domains.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and application of enterprise architecture governance, standards and assurance practices
  • Ability to prepare high-quality architecture artefacts, facilitate architecture decisions and guide solution and integration architects through relevant review and approval pathways.
  • High-level analytical, conceptual and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to assess current-state evidence, identify capability and architecture gaps, evaluate options, define non-functional requirements and assess dependencies, risks, supportability, transition impacts and whole-of-life implications.
  • Highly developed consultation, facilitation, communication, negotiation and influencing skills, with a collaborative, pragmatic and outcomes-focused approach
  • Ability to build agreement between executives, business and information owners, technical specialists, operational teams, governance bodies and external suppliers.

Highly desirable additional skills and experience:

  • Demonstrated experience providing solution and enterprise architecture leadership for SAP S/4HANA environments, including SAP S/4HANA Finance and RISE with SAP / Private Cloud Edition (PCE) architectures.
  • Experience with SAP enterprise environments, including SAP HR/Payroll, SAP S/4HANA Finance, data archiving, information lifecycle management, environment rationalisation or SAP Solution Manager transition
  • Demonstrated experience delivering major SAP version upgrades or platform migrations
  • TOGAF, ArchiMate or relevant architecture certifications
  • Knowledge of the Queensland Government Enterprise Architecture and Queensland Health architecture requirements

Benefits for You

  • Immediate start
  • Initial contract to 27 June 2027, with potential extension
  • Daily rate circa $1,200 + 12% Superannuation (PAYG)
  • Brisbane CBD office with hybrid working arrangements
  • Weekly pay cycles
  • No payroll fees/deductions from Kingston

job.title: AO3 Tribunal Officer
job.description:
About the Opportunity

Are you an organised and detail-oriented administration professional with strong typing skills and a passion for delivering exceptional customer service?

An exciting opportunity is available for an AO3 Tribunal Officer to join a busy Queensland Government team based in Brisbane CBD.

As Tribunal Officer, you will be responsible for providing a positive and supportive experience to workers, representatives, insurers and tribunal members throughout the tribunal process including on the day of hearing.

You will also be responsible for undertaking a range of administrative duties including accurate data entry, electronic file management and providing high quality administrative and secretariat support to the tribunal.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Coordinate and schedule tribunal appointments, liaising with workers, insurers, medical professionals and other stakeholders.
  • Prepare, type and distribute tribunal findings and documentation accurately and within required timeframes.
  • Maintain electronic case files, including PDF bookmarking, data entry and records management.
  • Provide administrative and secretariat support to tribunal members, ensuring hearings run smoothly.
  • Assist with virtual hearings, including meeting setup, connectivity testing and technical support.
  • Manage reception enquiries and provide professional, supportive customer service to visitors and stakeholders.
  • Coordinate tribunal rooms, regional travel arrangements and general administrative requirements.
  • Assist with invoice processing, staff training and continuous improvement initiatives.

What We're Looking For

  • Previous experience in administration, secretarial support or a similar role.
  • Strong typing, word processing and data entry skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Experience using Adobe, PDF documents and electronic records management systems.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to engage professionally with a diverse range of stakeholders.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to multitask, prioritise workloads and meet deadlines.
  • A professional, empathetic and resilient approach when dealing with sensitive or challenging situations.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a collaborative team environment.

Please note: Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a typing test and provide written responses to four selection criteria questions as part of the recruitment process.

Highly Regarded

  • Previous Dictaphone or audio transcription experience.
  • Experience in medical administration, legal administration, tribunals or similar environments.
  • Knowledge of medical terminology or workers' compensation processes and legislations

Benefits

  • Brisbane, CBD location
  • 6-month contract
  • $53.55 Per Hour + 12% Superannuation (PAYG Agency Contractor)
  • 36.25 hours per week, Monday to Friday (7.25 hrs per day)
  • Hybrid Working
  • Weekly pay cycle
